integrity: The proof distinguishes known character-polynomial foundations from the exact absolute-character sign and norm calculation. Finite checks corroborate rather than replace the all-rank derivation.
scientific_limitations: Sharp claims concern only the \(\ell^1\) and \(\ell^\infty\) central Fourier projection norms for the Specht module indexed by \((n-2,2)\), \(n\ge4\).
The proof does not determine endpoint norms of other irreducible blocks or interior \(\ell^p\) norms.
Independent validation and exhaustive historical-priority review have not been performed.
title: Exact endpoint norms of the quadratic Specht Fourier block on \(S_n\)
